findings.title: upsampled_count() counts events with no sample_weight as 0.
findings.body: `sum(sample_weight)` skips NULLs. In an allowlisted project, any event stored without a sample_weight adds nothing to the count. That includes events ingested before the project was allowlisted and events sent without error_sampling context. Error counts for those ranges drop, possibly to 0. The comment says the schema guarantees the column is set, but nothing shown enforces that. Default missing weights to 1: `Function("sum", [Function("ifNull", [Column("sample_weight"), 1])])`.

findings.title: An unrelated submodule gitlink `sentry-repo` was committed.
findings.body: The PR adds a gitlink to a nested `sentry-repo` checkout at commit a5d29095. The upsampling feature does not need it, and it looks like a local clone committed by accident. It can break checkouts and CI that run submodule init without a matching .gitmodules entry. Remove it from the change.

findings.title: The substring check treats negated or mixed queries as error-only.
findings.body: `"event.type:error" in query` also matches `!event.type:error` and `event.type:error OR event.type:transaction`. For those queries on the discover dataset, `count()` is rewritten to `upsampled_count()`, which counts the non-error rows by sample_weight (NULL, so 0) and returns wrong totals. Parse the query and require a positive `event.type:error` filter with no OR or negation, or fall back to no upsampling when the query is ambiguous.
